text:
lee_sre: Heads-up — planning to flip the runtime flag `predictive_cache_enabled` -> true in prod (EU region) today during the 10:30 PDT window. low-risk config change but impacts routing/kv-cache behavior.

alex_platform: Which service(s) are in scope? can we do a staged rollout?

lee_sre: scope = inference-router + cache-proxy (both namespaces). plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m, manual verification between steps. canary will be pinned to the eu1 pool.

maria_rel: I can own the rollout and smoke checks. I prefer safe default = false (so if something weird happens we revert to not using predictive cache). is that acceptable? :thinking_face: 

sam_dev: Agreed on safe default=false. Quick smoke checklist I'll run after each step: 1) 10 sample generation requests (golden prompts) 2) check 95p latency + error rate 3) confirm KV hit ratio metric rises for canary.

devops-bot: Reminder: Deploy window validated for 10:30 PDT by schedule-policy. No blocking maintenance windows.

jordan_pm: Timeline ok from product side. Please post a 1-line status after each phase so I can update stakeholders. Ops on-call is @lee_sre, backup @alex_platform.

lee_sre: Rollout commands: we'll patch the feature flag in our config service. quick patch example:```bash
# flip to true for eu1 only (canary)
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/flags/predictive_cache \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CONFIG_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"regions": ["eu1"], "state": "on", "percentage": 10}'
```

maria_rel: Smoke scripts I'll run (quick snippets):```bash
# health check
curl -sS https://eu1-inference.internal/health | jq .status
# golden prompt
curl -sS -X POST https://eu1-inference.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the text","max_tokens":32}' | jq .choices[0].text
```

sam_dev: Rollback steps: flip percentage to 0 or set state="off" then confirm traffic shifts within 30s. If we need an emergency rollback we have a k8s patch too:```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/config-service --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rollback":"now"}}}}}'
```

alex_platform: I'll monitor traces & p50/p95. if p95 increases >200ms or error rate >0.5% we stop and rollback. putting an alert on #eng-platform-alerts now.

maria_rel: I'll post updates: 10:32 — canary 10% smoke passed, 10:50 — 50% smoke in progress, 11:10 — full rollout complete (or rollback triggered).

lee_sre: one more: please avoid changing any unrelated flags in the same window. tagging @devops-bot for logs capture. :white_check_mark:

sam_dev: ack — I'll be available for quick rollback if needed.

alex_platform: ack. thanks team.

maria_rel: starting canary now, will report back in ~2m.
